show.description: Jia, a hardworking Hindi-medium village girl, prepares for her engineering entrance to change her father Jeevan’s life. But her uncle Ravi, aunt Meena and cousin Sidhu humiliate her, steal her savings, and label her a cheater and immoral girl. The village sarpanch punishes her father with 30 lashes. Jia refuses to break and bets her fate on the exam result—ready to make them pay when truth explodes.
